## Corrected ima diagnosis and fix

The previous interpretation of `customize_models/modify_model` code `100003`
as rate limiting was wrong. Safe diagnostics confirmed a duplicate-model response.
An identical target model already existed in the account, but AT-Switch tried to
modify its previously managed row into that duplicate configuration.

The fix reuses an existing exact match before modifying the previous managed row.
The endpoint, credential, model name and token limits must all match. Borrowed
rows and the formerly managed row are preserved during restoration and rollback.
Ambiguous matches are still rejected. Error mapping is scoped to the model
add/modify endpoints; HTTP 429 remains a separate rate-limit error. No arbitrary
server error messages or credentials are logged. Other Agent business code and
lockfiles are unchanged by this ima patch.

A regression test reproduced the original failure before the fix and now passes.
A second test covers failure while setting the second scene after borrowing a
model, including rollback and preservation of both rows. The real-account test
also compares all model rows exactly when the selected row is borrowed.

## Superseded evidence and release gate

Earlier source `9d8951e` passed installed Windows GLM switching and provider
ordinary/streaming/tool checks, but its DeepSeek roundtrip failed with the duplicate
conflict. That historical failure is resolved at the current source level; it
must not be described as a pending rate limit or a passed old-package test.
